Green Lantern Corps

Tomar-Tu

A Xudarian bearing a familiar legacy.

Tomar-Tu is a Xudarian Lantern connected to Tomar-Re’s legacy. His stories explore the difficulty of carrying an honored name while making consequential choices of his own.

Continuity: Main DC comics continuity; this profile follows the cited era rather than asserting a permanent present-day status.

Affiliation
Green Lantern Corps
First appearance
Green Lantern (1990) #5 (1990); joins the Corps in #24 (1992)
Story history — History and later developments — spoilers

Tomar-Tu first appears among the displaced communities on Oa’s Mosaic world and later joins the Corps. He is Tomar-Re’s son, but his own history should not be collapsed into his father’s. In Hal Jordan and the Green Lantern Corps #25, his killing of a prisoner and willingness to face judgment become central to the tension between the green and yellow forces.

Key Stories

  • Fracture
    Hal Jordan and the Green Lantern Corps #25 (2017); spoiler recap

Sources & further reading

  • DCU Guide (secondary): Tomar-Tu — biography and issue references
  • DC: Hal Jordan and the Green Lantern Corps #25 — Tomar-Tu’s decision

Reference scope: The secondary index distinguishes his introduction from joining. DC’s #25 recap confirms the later crisis. Appearing on the Mosaic world does not establish that he was born there.
